summary: A Wine prefix and a save on the data partition kept across a cold restart into a new root, as a root update or a new trial root leaves them: the prefix used again, the save loaded through it and through a new prefix, and the volume clean

cases.behavior: a Wine prefix and a save that rach2-game and Wine write on a data partition, an ext2 volume made on the host with rach2-install --data's options, since the ordinary kernel refuses raw writes, are kept across a cold restart into a new copy of the root, as a root update leaves the data partition: the existing prefix is used again without a new wineboot and still holds its registry value, the save loads through it and through a new prefix made beside it, which lacks the value, and the volume checks clean

execution.privileges: the rows run as the desktop account, an ordinary user; root makes and mounts the data partition
execution.cleanup: each row ends its Wine servers and Weston, reaps them and removes its scratch on every exit, and root unmounts /data before the scenario cuts the power; libetude-case stops QEMU and removes the passed overlays, the data volume's among them, keeping a failed attempt's disks and consoles

steps.does: boot an overlay of the GNU system's disk with an overlay of the empty data volume, mount it at /data, give the desktop account /data/games, and as that account make the prefix there through rach2-game, copy a 4 MiB save onto it through Wine's cmd, set the prefix's value HKCU\Software\Rach2 Save to the save's SHA-256 through reg.exe, unmount /data and cut the power

boot a second, new overlay of the GNU system's disk with the same overlay of the data volume, query the value through the existing prefix, copy the save off the data partition through Wine in it and in a new prefix, query the value in the new prefix, unmount /data and run e2fsck -fn on it

assertions.checks: the launcher prints its prefix line, Wine's copy of the save exits 0 with the payload's SHA-256, reg.exe sets and reads back the value, /data unmounts, and the row prints SAVEROW OK save

in the new root the existing prefix gets no new wineboot and reg.exe reads its value, the save copied through Wine in it and in a new prefix has the SHA-256 of the first boot, the new prefix lacks the value, /data unmounts, e2fsck -fn exits 0, and the row prints SAVEROW OK load

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the row needs QEMU's virgl display for Weston's GL and two boots of the GNU root on one data disk; the Lenovo's own form is 80-9.6's step
